summary.en: A challenge collection where every entry must live in a single HTML file — stuffed with quirky mini-games.
summary.zh: 只能用「一个 HTML 文件」创作的挑战合集，里面塞满了各种脑洞小游戏。

description.en: A grab bag of experiments: each sub-project follows its own rules, spanning shooters, puzzles, simulators, music toys and more.
description.zh: 合集形式，每个子项目独立规则：有射击、解谜、模拟器、音乐玩具等，玩法各不相同。

tip.en: A treasure chest for inspiration and obscure mini-games. Pick out the most polished ones and lift them straight into your site — free content, all single-file with zero dependencies.
tip.zh: 找灵感/找冷门小游戏的宝库。挑几个完成度高的直接搬进站点，等于白捡一批内容，且全部单文件、零依赖。
